It's horrible to think of what the[XENO:n ]
Mechon did to Colony 6.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Yes. The devastation here was[XENO:n ]
far worse than in Colony 9.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]There were two things we had that[XENO:n ]
they didn't: Shulk and the Monado.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Yes. Not that their Defence Force[XENO:n ]
was anything to sneeze at...[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But in the end, the Mechon just[XENO:n ]
overwhelmed them.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:sel sel=・It makes me sad./・We should say sorry. ][XENO:del del=all ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]So many lives lost.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]And Carna lost someone[XENO:n ]
so close to her.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Many lives were sacrificed. More[XENO:n ]
than could ever be justified.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Even now that I know the reasons[XENO:n ]
behind the Mechon's actions.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Everyone here just wanted to[XENO:n ]
protect the people they loved.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]They didn't deserve this.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]To protect those who we love,[XENO:n ]
we often must sacrifice everything.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT12 ][XENO:sel sel=・But why, Dunban?/・It must have been really tough. ][XENO:del del=all ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]Why couldn't we have[XENO:n ]
all lived in peace?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT16 ]Hindsight is a wonderful thing,[XENO:n ]
Fiorung. But what's done is done.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I, too, wish we could have[XENO:n ]
settled our differences sooner.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Unfortunately, it was not to be.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT18 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Just think... If this stupid war with[XENO:n ]
the Mechon had never happened...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I know.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]We might have had an even better[XENO:n ]
peace than we're striving for.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But I'll tell you a secret, Fiorung.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I think I fit better into the world[XENO:n ]
we're living in now.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Me too, Dunban.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]The world is a complicated place,[XENO:n ]
with all its war and struggle.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But I can't quite imagine life[XENO:n ]
without all that.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Hopefully Colony 6 is free of[XENO:n ]
it now, though.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]The people here deserve[XENO:n ]
a real home.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Yeah,[XENO:n ]
you're right.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]We've got to help with the reconstruction, then![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]You do your part too, Onii-chan![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT16 ]Of[XENO:n ]
course.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But don't push yourself, all right?[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]You can leave the heavy[XENO:n ]
lifting to Rein, you know.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT16 ]I know, I know.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Anyway, we'd better not keep[XENO:n ]
Shulk waiting. He'll start to worry.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT18 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]I still remember[XENO:n ]
it even now.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Shulk's face and his cry when I charged[XENO:n ]
at that black Machine God Soldier...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT16 ]Shulk was a wreck after that. I'd[XENO:n ]
never seen the boy so distraught.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I imagine that's how the[XENO:n ]
people of Colony 6 felt.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]I made up my mind after that.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I decided I'd never endanger[XENO:n ]
myself so thoughtlessly again.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT18 ]I should hope so too, Fiorung.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I won't forget his cries, and[XENO:n ]
I don't wish to hear them again.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I'll be more careful in future.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]That's my promise to you, Dunban.[XENO:n ]
I won't throw my life away.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Yeah. Please do.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]It wouldn't just be Shulk who's sad.[XENO:n ]
Rein, the others and I would be too.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I know. It was a silly thing to do.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]No matter how tough the battle is,[XENO:n ]
how scary it gets...[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]We all need to stick together.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Yes. That's the only way.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]OK! I think it's time we were[XENO:n ]
getting back to the others.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]They might be getting worried.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]After what happened, I bet Shulk[XENO:n ]
is afraid to let me out of his sight.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Come on, Dunban, hurry it up![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:type type=think ][XENO:jaw jaw=off ][XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I promise you, Fiorung... I'll never[XENO:n ]
let you come to such harm again.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I mean...we should say something.[XENO:n ]
You know, to the survivors.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT16 ]What would we say?[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]'Sorry we didn't get here in time[XENO:n ]
with our magical sword.'[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]How well would they take that?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]I know, but...[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Here we are, alive and well.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]We've barely even helped with[XENO:n ]
the reconstruction.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]We could give money or food, but[XENO:n ]
I feel like that wouldn't be enough.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT18 ]There's only so much we can do.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Ultimately, the people who live[XENO:n ]
here have to rebuild their lives.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]And that's up to them.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ][XENO:sel sel=・Is that really how you feel?/・I guess you're right. ][XENO:del del=all ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]It is.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I know it's hard not to worry.[XENO:n ]
It's not as if I don't want to help.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But don't forget we have another[XENO:n ]
task ahead of us.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]You're right, as always.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]We need to finish what we set out[XENO:n ]
to do. That's what matters most.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]And don't forget it benefits[XENO:n ]
them as much as us.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]We're fighting for the entire world.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]You're strong, Onii-chan.[XENO:n ]
I still can't think that way.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT16 ]It's all a matter of perspective.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But I understand why you find[XENO:n ]
it difficult to deal with this.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]It just means you truly care.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Thank you.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]The truth is, my mind is made up.[XENO:n ]
It's my heart that wavers.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I'm sorry, Dunban.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT18 ]What are you apologising for?[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]You're my sister, and I wouldn't[XENO:n ]
want you to be any other way.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I'm glad you're here by my side.[XENO:n ]
You make me proud.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Eurgh, I can't believe you just[XENO:n ]
said all that! How embarrassing![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Right, come on. We need to get[XENO:n ]
back. Can't keep Shulk waiting![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]OK, I get the message.[XENO:n ]
Come on then.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]So you see that they have to[XENO:n ]
do this with their own hands.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]It's an accomplishment that will[XENO:n ]
stay with them forever.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]If we did it all for them,[XENO:n ]
it wouldn't be the same.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I see! That's[XENO:n ]
my Onii-chan![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]You do have[XENO:n ]
some wise words![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]I think it's just that I have a few[XENO:n ]
years on you and the others.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]When you get to my age, you'll[XENO:n ]
come to the same conclusion.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]I don't know about that.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I think you can say that because of all[XENO:n ]
the experiences you've had, Onii-chan.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Before my injury, I was fortunate[XENO:n ]
enough to see a lot of Giant God.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]And I rebuilt our house more than[XENO:n ]
a few times.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]I remember![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]We rebuilt our home, and that's[XENO:n ]
what makes it so special.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]That feeling of getting back on our[XENO:n ]
feet made me happy and confident.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]That's exactly what I'm[XENO:n ]
talking about.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Sounds like my work here is done.[XENO:n ]
How about we look for the others?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]OK! Lots to do.[XENO:n ]
And lots to see as well![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
